text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Tamamo Cross and Oguri Cap talk about the circumstances in which they were raised. Despite both of them coming from underprivileged backgrounds, their viewpoints couldn't be more different.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap's strength comes from how full she has grown on the love from those around her, while Tamamo Cross's strength is born of hunger instead.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Oguri Cap is the yin to Tamamo Cross's yang—an alternate version of her. And that's precisely why Oguri Cap triggers such an intense competitive drive in her.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With Oguri Cap also considering Tamamo Cross to be her one-and-only rival, she abandons the Classic Triple Crown tour and announces her intention to run in the autumn Tenno Sho.
